entries.name: FRICKIN' Fried Chicken
entries.description: Nashville-style hot chicken spin-off from the Birdies Bangkok team, now open at PRIME Thonglor with heat levels from Naked to Tingly; Phuket branch next.

entries.name: Jaan Ranjuan
entries.description: New Thai-flavoured cocktail and tea lounge debuting as an extension of one-Michelin-star Saneh Jaan for its tenth anniversary.

entries.name: Blue Bottle Coffee EmQuartier
entries.description: Blue Bottle's Thailand flagship opened Aug 28 with 200+ sqm, 80 seats, a full pour-over bar and branch-exclusive products.

entries.name: Blue Bottle Coffee Central Park
entries.description: Blue Bottle's first Thai store, opened Aug 21, and the first in Southeast Asia with a full Kyoto-Style Espresso Tap Bar.

entries.name: VUUR by Jacob Jan Boerma
entries.description: Fine-dining debut inside the new Happitat complex from the Dutch chef who led De Leest to three Michelin stars.

entries.name: SING LANG
entries.description: New Thai concept at Happitat from chef Thaninthorn Chantrawan of one-Michelin-star Chim by Siam Wisdom.

entries.name: Happitat Bang Na
entries.description: CP Axtra's THB 15bn, 200,000 sqm lifestyle landmark opened Aug 21 with 100+ restaurants and cafes across three themed zones.

entries.name: EGGDAY x On Lok Yun
entries.description: New collaboration menu pairing EGGDAY's brioche French toast with On Lok Yun's 90-year-old custard recipe, from B89.

entries.name: Bo.bkk
entries.description: Bagel-and-coffee cafe under a Sathon apartment block, pet-friendly with Saturday morning run club; opening date not firmly confirmed.

entries.name: Cova Bangkok
entries.description: 200-year-old Milanese pasticceria at One Bangkok's The Storeys, reported early August; coffee, all-day dining, afternoon tea and aperitivo.

trend_note: The week belonged to big-format arrivals - Blue Bottle's two-store Thailand entry and the 100-venue Happitat opening in Bang Na - rather than independent neighbourhood debuts, with international coffee brands and Michelin-pedigree chefs both anchoring into new mall developments.
